mapper.select: select userdata_details.username || ' 送出報價單' as title, '' as status from "interviewworks_schema"."userdata_details" userdata_details where userdata_details.is_active = '1' and userdata_details.is_active_notifications = '1' and userdata_details.tracking_number is null

select '編號(' || quotations.quotation_id || ') ' || quotations.username || ' 報價單通知' as title, quotations.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations where quotations.status in ('estimate', 'sent') and username = #{username}

select '編號(' || orders.order_id || ') ' || quotations.username || ' 訂單通知' as title, orders.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id where quotations.status in ('accepted') and orders.status in ('pending')

select '追蹤號碼(' || shipments.tracking_number || ') ' || quotations.username || ' 出貨單通知' as title, shipments.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."shipments" shipments inner join "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders on shipments.order_id = orders.order_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."payments" payments on orders.order_id = payments.order_id where shipments.status in ('preparing', 'shipped', 'delivered') and payments.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and username = #{username}

select '追蹤號碼(' || shipments.tracking_number || ') ' || quotations.username || ' 付款通知' as title, payments.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."payments" payments inner join "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders on payments.order_id = orders.order_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."shipments" shipments on orders.order_id = shipments.order_id where shipments.status in ('preparing', 'shipped', 'delivered') and payments.status in ('unpaid', 'partial') and username = #{username}

select '追蹤號碼(' || shipments.tracking_number || ') ' || quotations.username || ' 出貨單通知' as title, shipments.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."shipments" shipments inner join "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders on shipments.order_id = orders.order_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."payments" payments on orders.order_id = payments.order_id where shipments.status in ('preparing', 'shipped') and payments.status in ('partial')

select '追蹤號碼(' || shipments.tracking_number || ') ' || quotations.username || ' 付款通知' as title, payments.status as status from "interviewworks_schema"."payments" payments inner join "interviewworks_schema"."orders" orders on payments.order_id = orders.order_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."quotations" quotations on orders.quotation_id = quotations.quotation_id inner join "interviewworks_schema"."shipments" shipments on orders.order_id = shipments.order_id where shipments.status in ('preparing', 'shipped') and payments.status in ('paid')
